notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024, as the city reported them in its Annual Financial Report to the Illinois Comptroller. Not a budget.

Depreciation ($450,342) is left out; capital outlay is counted when paid.
Capital outlay outside utility funds ($324,522) is reported without a function, so it is spread over the city's services in proportion to their spending.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is bonds, contracts and other long-term debt outstanding at year end (beginning balance plus new debt less debt retired), as reported.

Political money is not scored: no candidates for mayor or village president, council or board, clerk and other local offices of City of Carterville reported contributions to the State Board of Elections since 2023.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.
